Why is this patch OK? Don't you _also_ need to disable PSS in the shim?

> Why is this patch OK? Don't you also need to disable PSS in the shim?

This patch bumps us to boringssl revision "57e929f3c8c3d412639eb123382c79ff3bdc3ed3", the one that introduced RSA-PSS support for TLS 1.2. I experimented at first with disabling PSS signature schemes but found that bumping was the better option and we could disable fewer tests that way.
OK. LGTM.
Don't you also need changes to HandleCertificateRequest?

> Don't you also need changes to HandleCertificateRequest?

The (context.len > 0) check was added to it in the very first commit. So we're currently checking in HandleCertificate and HandleCertificateRequest. And we're sending the right thing in SendCertificateRequest.
